newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy 10-yr Btp/Bund spread narrows to new record.
newsitem.headline: Italy 10-yr Btp/Bund spread narrows to new record.

text.p: The spread between the February 2007 Italian Btp bond and the benchmark July 2007 German bund narrowed to a new record low of 120 basis points.
The spread had set a previous all-time low of 121 bps on Thursday as the Btp September Liffe future contract rose to a record high at 133.70.

At 0935 GMT, the spread had gone back out to 122 bps. The September Btp was 56 bps higher at 133.20 after a morning high of 133.34. The lira was firmer against the mark at a quoted 978.35/8.65 after an earlier 977.55 high.
